blocks.text: The “Kapuso Mo, Jessica Soho” team released a statement offering clarification and apology over a recent “Gabi ng Lagim XIV” episode, which centered on a wood carving made by an artist from Paete, Laguna. In the episode entitled “Ukit” which aired on Sunday, Nov. 1, Lily (formerly Callalily) guitarist Nathan Reyes shared how he started having eerie experiences after he took home a wood carving that was gifted to them after their gig in Paete. “‘Yung cousin ko, pumunta sa dalawang albularyo na parehas ‘yung sinabi… Possessed daw ang inuwi naming inukit na plaka!” Reyes said.
